operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are simple lowercase ASCII (driver, school, school_bus, Driver_ID, If_full_time); no spaces or mixed case, but the spec's quoting rule still applies.
Tiny tables (12/7/5 rows) — no rowid sampling or max_rows_per_table pressure; original_values are complete.
school_bus has a composite PK (School_ID, Driver_ID) and two FKs to driver and school; both parents exist and are unique on their PKs.
If_full_time declared 'bool' but storage class is text with values 'T'/'F' — declared type dispatches to Bool fuzzer, which emits True/False/1/0, contradicting the stored 'T'/'F'.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE indexes, no views/triggers; all columns nullable in DDL.
FK parent columns (driver.Driver_ID, school.School_ID) are INTEGER PKs, so FK child draws are integer values from the parent's final filtered column.
No self-references, no dangling FKs, no non-unique parents.
Grade/Location samples contain en-dash (–) and commas — String fuzzer's CHARSET lacks these, so fresh strings won't reproduce them.
Party has only 2 distinct values (Dem/Rep); Home_city 5; Type 3 — small literal pools per column.
School_ID in school_bus samples (1,3,4,5,7) are a subset of school's 1..7; Driver_ID samples (10,4,3,7,9) subset of driver's 1..12.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on Driver_ID/School_ID/Age/Years_Working: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from INT (no args -> scale 0, so [-1,1] plus +-1/+-2 perturbation) — implausible IDs/ages, likely FN on range predicates.

String fuzzer on Name/Party/Home_city/Grade/School/Location/Type: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length 0..20 with 0.5 contaminate — destroys 'Dem'/'Rep'/'Public' ties, likely FP on equality/IN and FN on LIKE patterns.
Bool fuzzer on If_full_time emits True/False (Python bools) not 'T'/'F' — stored as 1/0 in sqlite; queries filtering ='T' will miss, =1 may hit.
Composite PK (School_ID,Driver_ID) in school_bus: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate pairs; with tiny sizes (1+30u) collisions rare, so few drops.

FK draws from parent's FINAL filtered column: driver/school PKs are single-column PKs -> max_l0=inf, so many fresh draws; child FK values may reference parent IDs that were dropped by PK dedup only if parent had dupes (it won't, PK unique).

choose_table_sizes: level 0 = driver,school (1+30u each), level 1 = school_bus (x4) — school_bus often larger than parents, so FK draws with replacement create many duplicate (School_ID,Driver_ID) pairs -> heavy PK dedup, shrinking school_bus.
Literal pool from train SQL: Party/Type/Home_city literals ('Dem','Rep','Public',...) enter the pool and are sampled with p=0.2, giving some plausible values but diluted by fresh strings.
checked=False everywhere, so p stays 0.2 (or 0 w.p. 0.3 at instance level) — no CHECK-driven p=0.
No Date/Time columns, so Date/Time fuzzers unused; no crash-fallback types.

Known misses: FN from Number fuzzer's tiny [-1,1] range for Age/Years_Working (real 2..46) and from String fuzzer losing 'Dem'/'Rep' ties; FP from missing duplicate (School_ID,Driver_ID) pairs after PK dedup and from Bool True/False vs 'T'/'F'.
